doc: Where each Boki is found (owner core principle 2, 2026-11-11; docs/design/MODE_BOKI.md). Every species sits in exactly one mode. Each mode has a COMMON / RARE / VERY RARE spawn table; gate is the lowest difficulty of that mode a tier spawns at (gate_doc says what the number counts). Expedition's legendaries are a separate roll, not a tier. Read through ModeBoki (scripts/core/mode_boki.gd), checked by --mode-boki-check. The spawn pools (Expedition wild kin in match.gd and spawn_plan.gd, garden visitors in garden_visitor.gd) read it only when live is true. live is false until the owner answers the MODE_BOKI.md questions: then Expedition draws every non-legendary species (Data.common_kin) and any garden visitor that fits.

expedition.name: Expedition: Hollow Crown
expedition.gate_doc: Expedition difficulty: the Data.TIERS index (0 The Meadow, 1 Dusk Isles, 2 The Hollow).

legendary.per_match_doc: Chance a match on this map spawns one legendary, picked evenly from species (owner 2026-11-09: under 30%, at most one a match). Today each boss still drops its own egg when killed; nothing rolls this yet.

heart_raid.name: Heart Raid (prototype)
heart_raid.gate_doc: Heart Raid difficulty level, 0 the easiest. The mode has no levels yet.

garden_visitors.name: Garden visitors
garden_visitors.gate_doc: Garden zones open (garden_zones.json; 1 = only the start zone). A visitor still needs its own zone open (garden_visitor.json groups).
